title: fieldwork reqwest dep uses default features (native-tls)
description: fieldwork/Cargo.toml line 41: reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["json"], optional = true } -- this does not set default-features = false, so it pulls in reqwest's default TLS backend (native-tls/OpenSSL). All three downstream servers (smallhold, gaja, broadside) explicitly use default-features = false with rustls-tls. Because Cargo unifies features additively, the final binary compiles both native-tls AND rustls-tls, adding unnecessary binary size and attack surface. Fix: add default-features = false to fieldwork's reqwest dep and explicitly specify the TLS backend, or let the downstream server control TLS selection by not enabling any TLS feature in fieldwork.
close_reason: Fixed: reqwest dep now has default-features = false.
